title: Fixed Curved-Runner Arm Rocking Chair
description: One original complete fixed wooden arm rocking-chair appearance. Two continuous closed curved runners rise at both front and rear ends and rest on short central facets. A gently dished thick seat, four frame supports, two whole rounded-end armboards with front supports, three inclined back slats and a high crest form a complete armchair above the runners. Transverse low ties and side bearers complete the static support appearance. Entire numeric construction is newly authored, not the old four-foot dining chair or long flat-runner kick sled resized. Two opaque constant wood-colour PBR materials, no textures. One whole prop, zero scenes. Only the shown fixed resting pose: no actual motion, balance, rocking sweep, occupant suitability, ergonomics, load, manufacture or safety certification.
